Deep Thinkers · cinematic reels

Three serious, dark 9:16 reels (15–18s, looping) built on the same engine as the Butterfly & Pig page. One thinker, one line, one slow reveal each.

Reel 1 · Dostoevsky · The wrong place (15s)

DEEP THINKERS · I
Nothing kills the human soullike being in the wrong placewith the wrong people.FYODOR DOSTOEVSKY

Reel 2 · Leonardo da Vinci · Mirror writing (15s)

DEEP THINKERS · II
LEONARDO WROTE IN MIRROR
Not to punish evilis equivalent toauthorizing it.
LEONARDO DA VINCI

Reel 3 · Dostoevsky · The price of truth (18s)

DEEP THINKERS · III
If all the sufferings
of children
go to swell the sum of sufferings
which was necessary
to pay for truth,
THENI PROTEST
that the truth is
not worth such a price.FYODOR DOSTOEVSKY · THE BROTHERS KARAMAZOV
Notes: Reel 2 shows the quote mirrored, like Leonardo’s notebooks, then flips it readable. Reel 3 is Ivan’s “rebellion” speech from The Brothers Karamazov; the other two lines are widely attributed to Dostoevsky and Leonardo but hard to source, so check them before posting if accuracy matters. To export, set the browser window so the reel is fully visible and screen-record it at 9:16; the dashed “Safe zones” box marks what Instagram/TikTok UI leaves clear.
